metadata.source: BhoomiIntel Sample Land Governance GeoJSON (SIH PS 26019)
metadata.disclaimer: Sample data for demonstration and policy modeling purposes — clearly labeled as sample data

properties.name: Pune
common_dispute_types: Peri-urban Agricultural-to-Non-Agricultural Conversion Disputes
Family Partition and Succession Titling Gaps
Cadastral Map Inaccuracies (Pot-Hissa Inconsistencies)
Industrial Corridor Land Acquisition Compensation
properties.key_challenges: Rapid urbanization pressure along IT corridors causing fragmented parcel speculation and legacy 7/12 record discrepancies.

properties.name: Varanasi
common_dispute_types: Ganga Riverine Diara Land Accretion & Diluvion Rights
Gram Sabha Common Land Encroachment
Generational Khata/Khatauni Co-sharing Litigations
Temple/Religious Trust Land Leases
properties.key_challenges: High agricultural parcel subdivision index with multiple co-tenants per plot (Khatauni), compounded by seasonal riverine shifting boundaries.

properties.name: Kanchipuram
common_dispute_types: Eri (Irrigation Tank) Poramboke (Government Commons) Encroachment
Automotive & Electronics Industrial Corridor Buffer Disagreements
Patta Chitta Record Sync Glitches
Coastal/Wetland Real Estate Boundary Overlaps
properties.key_challenges: Pressure on historic traditional tank irrigation commons (Eri poramboke) due to industrial spillover and real estate plotting.

properties.name: Kamrup Metropolitan
common_dispute_types: Brahmaputra Flood Char/Chapori Sandbank Re-emergence Claims
Wetland (Deepor Beel Ramsar Site) Buffer Encroachments
Tribal Belt & Block Transfer Violations (Assam Land & Revenue Reg)
Hillslope Eco-sensitive Settlement Conflicts
properties.key_challenges: Extreme annual river erosion displacing titleholders, creating complex claims over newly emerged sediment islands (chars).

properties.name: Bengaluru Rural
common_dispute_types: Gomala (Village Grazing Land) Regularization Disputes
SC/ST PTCL Act (Prohibition of Transfer of Certain Lands) Claims
Bhoomi Portal vs Survey Settlement & Land Records Inconsistencies
Airport Expressway Special Investment Region Acquisitions
properties.key_challenges: High speculative real estate valuation driving aggressive litigation on historical grantee lands and village commons.

properties.name: Jodhpur
common_dispute_types: Sacred Groves (Oran) & Grazing Commons (Gauchar) Boundary Litigations
Mega Solar Park & Transmission Corridor Land Leases
Arid Pasture Rights vs Revenue Land Allotment
Colonization Land Ceiling Exceptions in Canal Irrigation Zones
properties.key_challenges: Large desert commons (Oran and Gauchar) lacking demarcated cadastral boundaries, colliding with renewable energy infrastructure projects.

properties.name: Sambalpur
common_dispute_types: Forest Rights Act (FRA) Individual & Community Rights Recognition
Coal Mining & Thermal Power Land Rehabilitation Gaps
Hirakud Reservoir Submerged Land Resurvey Litigations
Scheduled Tribe Land Non-Alienation Regulations (OSATIP Act)
properties.key_challenges: Overlap of dense customary forest tracts with mineral leases, necessitating precise FRA cadastral titling to safeguard tribal livelihoods.

properties.name: Wayanad
common_dispute_types: Ecologically Fragile Land (EFL) Demarcation & Plantation Exemptions
Landslide Risk Red-Zone Relocation & Resettlement Title Grievances
Adivasi Vested Forest Land Allotment Disputes
Inter-state Border Agricultural Buffer Zone Discrepancies
properties.key_challenges: Severe climate vulnerability to extreme precipitation landslides requiring spatial zoning bans, balanced against tribal and plantation smallholder tenure.
